question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Squawk
solution:
The correct answer is '**Scream**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Squawk**' is '**Scream**'.
 
• **Squawk**: to make a loud unpleasant noise. (जोर से अप्रिय शोर करने के लिए)
 
 
• *Example: She gave a very loud **squawk** at this point which we considered a good sign.*
 
 
 
• **Scream**: to cry out loudly in a high voice because you are afraid, excited, angry, in pain, etc. [ज़ोर से चीख़ना (डर, उत्तेजना, ग़ुस्‍सा, दर्द आदि के कारण)]
 
 
• *Example: She saw a rat and **screamed** out.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Scream.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Suggest**: to mention a plan or an idea that you have for somebody to discuss or consider. [(चर्चा या विचार हेतु) कोई सुझाव देना (किसी योजना या राय का उल्‍लेख करना)]
 
• **Explore**: to travel around a place, etc. in order to learn about it. (किसी जगह के विषय में जानकारी प्राप्त करने के लिए उसका भ्रमण करना, खोजयात्रा करना)
 
• **Connote**: (of a fact) imply as a consequence or condition. [(किसी तथ्य का) परिणाम या स्थिति के रूप में]
